adds.title: Human Rights Campaign travel advisory
adds.summary: Florida enacted SB 254 with a Physicians Only provision prohibiting nurse practitioners and physician assistants from providing gender-affirming care to transgender adults, disrupting care for an estimated 80%+ of transgender clinic patients with temporary or permanent suspensions after signing, and enacted an anti-trans bathroom law effective July 1, 2023 banning transgender people from using restrooms and changing facilities matching their lived gender in publicly-owned or leased airports, government buildings, convention centers, parks, school campuses and stadiums and imposing criminal penalties on visitors and residents alike who refuse to leave when asked.
